VB-CABLE Virtual Audio Device by VB-Audio Software / Vincent Burel.
Official origin: https://www.vb-cable.com/ and https://vb-audio.com/Cable/
VB-CABLE is donationware. Contributions and license purchases are welcome:
https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm

Localist forwards received Wi-Fi/USB network audio to the existing CABLE Input
playback endpoint. Select CABLE Output as the microphone in the destination app.
Each enabled sender reserves a separate, unused cable; Localist never combines
senders into one microphone. The ordinary package provides one independent cable.
Additional A/B/C/D cables require separately licensed vendor packages supplied by
the user; those packages are not included here.

The official base driver package is redistributed unchanged, including its
original readme/license. Its SYS/INF/CAT are not renamed or modified. Current
vendor distribution terms explicitly permit including the base VB-CABLE package
and silent installation while preserving its origin and donationware model.
Professional/organizational deployments must observe the vendor's paid licensing
requirements. VB-CABLE A+B and C+D are not bundled.

Localist does not uninstall the shared VB-CABLE driver when Localist is removed:
other applications or the user may rely on it. Use the official VB-CABLE installer
to remove the driver deliberately. No system default audio endpoint is changed.

Copyright and all rights to VB-CABLE remain with its original author.
